decision.question: F2-A10 (f), as clarified (clarifications.md), said that below three quarters of full the forecast falls as the level rises. On the held-out set, run once on the tested commit (81eadac9), it does on 110 of 111 cases below three quarters: adv-h-1’s vocal, at 32, reads 0.828, 0.899 and 0.764 at its level, a third and two thirds of the way to full. The twenty sessions’ growth falls with the level there, as the model gives it (tests/decisions-advice.test.ts, [N], played on tuning seeds). The forecast is in points of result, and what an ability point is worth on the work isn’t monotone in the level everywhere: it is the judge’s curve, and the forecast reads it truly (adv-h-1 forecast 0.828 and brought 1.058; F2-A10 (e) holds). Preparation apart from training holds on 120 of 120, and near mastery the ladder falls on 30 of 30. Should (f)’s diminishing returns be read in the growth the twenty sessions bring, with the forecast’s points left to the judge’s curve; or does (f) stay not met as clarified?
decision.evidence: docs/verification/completion-2026-10-16/advice/held-out-summary.json (held-out F2-A10: f.prepApart 120 of 120, f.ladderFalls 30 of 30 near mastery); docs/verification/completion-2026-10-16/advice/held-out-adv-h-0-9.json (adv-h-1’s f.ladder); clarifications.md, F2-A10 (f), with brief 10’s result kept
decision.recommendation: Read (f)’s diminishing returns in the growth the model gives (below three quarters of full each rung brings less, from there to full the same), held by the played test on tuning seeds, and leave the forecast’s points to the judge’s curve, which the forecast reads truly. That reading was formed after the held-out run, so it’s the owner’s to approve, not adopted here; until then (f) is counted not met.

On the held-out set, run once on the tested commit (81eadac9), it does on 116 of 120. In the four that didn’t (adv-h-1 vocal at 32, adv-h-22 emotional depth at 27, adv-h-102 memory at 91, adv-h-111 focus at 93), the forecast itself fell, so (h) as written holds there; the input’s own part rose because what an ability point is worth on the work isn’t monotone in the level (the judge’s curve, as in (f)). As written, the forecast fell on 113 of 120; the 7 that rose (adv-h-91, 100, 103, 106, 107, 110, 118, all near mastery) rose by a thousandth or less, each within discipline’s lift and said. Every case fell, or rose within discipline’s lift and said: 120 of 120. The first-named changed wherever another led, 51 of 51. Should (h) read: after the twenty sessions the forecast falls, or a rise is no more than discipline’s lift and is said; or does (h) stay not met, as written and as clarified?
